title: Post RC-PCR Pooling of Nimagen SARS CoV-2 Library Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs the post RC-PCR pooling of the [Nimagen SARS CoV-2 Library Prep](https://www.nimagen.com/shop/products/rc-cov096/easyseq-sars-cov-2-novel-coronavirus-whole-genome-sequencing-kit). It has the option to pool samples from a variety of 384 well plates. The 384 well plate is divided into four quadrants and each quadrant can have up to 12 columns of samples, yielding a total of 48 columns worth of samples on a full plate. **Note:** The diagram above color coordinates the four quadrant positions. Each quadrant can take up to 12 columns worth of samples. The diagram above shows 1 column worth of samples. --- * [Opentrons 200uL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-200ul-filter-tips) * [Opentrons 20uL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [4-titude FrameStar 384 Well Plate](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/95040450#/95040450) * [BIOplastics 384 Well Plate](https://www.bioplastics.com/productdetails.aspx?code=B70515) * [Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 384 Well](https://online-shop.eppendorf.co.uk/UK-en/Laboratory-Consumables-44512/Plates-44516/Eppendorf-twin.tec-PCR-Plates-LoBind-PF-58208.html#Accessory) * [Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 96 Well](https://online-shop.eppendorf.co.uk/UK-en/Laboratory-Consumables-44512/Plates-44516/Eppendorf-twin.tec-PCR-Plates-LoBind-PF-58208.html#Accessory) * [P300 Single Channel GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984549109789) * [P20 Multichannel GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) For more detailed information on compatible labware, please visit our [Labware Library](https://labware.opentrons.com/). --- **Deck Setup** **Note: Slots 9, 10, 11 contain empty tip racks for the Opentrons 20 uL tips.** **Protocol Steps** 1. steps.title: Gather consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons 200 µL Filter Tips, Opentrons 20 µL Filter Tips, 4‑titude FrameStar 384‑Well Plate, BIOplastics 384‑Well Plate, Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 384‑Well Plate, Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 96‑Well Plate, P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 pipette, P20 Multichannel GEN2 pipette, and the Nimagen SARS‑CoV‑2 Library Prep kit.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map, placing empty tip racks for the Opentrons 20 µL tips in slots 9, 10, and 11, and load the 384‑well donor plate and any other required labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Prepare protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file, unzip it if necessary, upload any custom labware JSON files via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware, then upload the protocol Python file (.py) in the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Calibrate robot
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tip racks, and pipettes (P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 and P20 Multichannel GEN2) following the on‑screen instructions and the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Mix and transfer
steps.instruction: Mix column in the 384‑well donor plate, then transfer samp

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
